claims: San Antonio Spurs are playing Game 1 of the NBA Playoffs against the Portland Trail Blazers.
Game 1 starts at 6 PM PT/8 PM CT/9 PM ET.
Game 1 is at the Frost Bank Center.
Game 1 is available to stream on Peacock.
Portland Trail Blazers (No. 7) at San Antonio Spurs (No. 2).
Game 1 time is 6:00 PM Pacific / 8:00 PM Central.
Venue for Game 1 is Frost Bank Center, San Antonio, TX.
Game 1 TV/Stream: NBC, Peacock, and Sling TV.
Game 1 is the first game of the Western Conference Quarterfinals series.
Game 2 is scheduled for Tuesday, April 21, 2026, at 7 PM PDT.
